summary_claims.claim: Extends the crime of sexual exploitation of a child to downloading, streaming or accessing a depiction, exempting a child who only viewed a stream
Mandated reporters must report digitally altered or AI-generated matter depicting a minor

scope.note: The extractor's scope_note is right: a child-exploitation law that brings AI-generated material into mandated reporting.
